record_title: Dimension-threshold classification of weighted block identities
provenance: The finite-strict-singularity obstruction for weighted outer-exponent block identities is exactly the persistence of arbitrarily large finite-dimensional blocks above a positive weight threshold; Auerbach factorization through the scalar formal inclusion gives the converse and a Bernstein-number envelope.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge and excludes the classical scalar formal inclusion, Milman's separation examples, and standard Bernstein-number facts. Milman's 1970 Russian paper and Pietsch's 1978 Operator Ideals were not exhaustively inspected, so an equivalent block formulation under older terminology remains a residual risk.
